templateOptions.label: Data Source
templateOptions.description: The Oracle connection string data source, format [server]:[port]/[database].

templateOptions.label: Username
templateOptions.description: The username of the Oracle service account used by HelloID. Leave both Username and Password empty to use Oracle integrated security with the Windows account running the HelloID Agent.

templateOptions.label: Password
templateOptions.description: The password of the Oracle service account. Leave both Username and Password empty to use Oracle integrated security.

templateOptions.label: Use DROP USER ... CASCADE on delete
templateOptions.description: If enabled, delete performs 'DROP USER <username> CASCADE'. If disabled, delete performs a plain 'DROP USER <username>' (fails if the user owns database objects).
